manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Untagged optional uint256 legacy claim index; native Option adds a tag.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Untagged optional uint256 legacy claim index; native Option adds a tag.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Absent means zero remaining bits, present is exactly uint64 without a tag.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Absent means zero remaining bits, present is exactly uint64 without a tag.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Optional payout forwarding reference selected by remaining refs, without a Maybe tag.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Optional payout forwarding reference selected by remaining refs, without a Maybe tag.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Initial delay-only and runtime pending-updates suffix differ without a presence tag.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Initial delay-only and runtime pending-updates suffix differ without a presence tag.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Router initial/runtime pending suffix differs from pool and has no presence tag.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Router initial/runtime pending suffix differs from pool and has no presence tag.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Zero/one/two remaining role refs encode distinct cases without enum tags.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Zero/one/two remaining role refs encode distinct cases without enum tags.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Preserve untagged settings ref and optional ignored SDK Maybe bit independently.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Preserve untagged settings ref and optional ignored SDK Maybe bit independently.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Optional inline funding order selected by remaining data with no tag.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Optional inline funding order selected by remaining data with no tag.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Optional inline address/amount target selected by remaining length with no tag.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Optional inline address/amount target selected by remaining length with no tag.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Optional indexer log is an untagged reference, not native tagged Option.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Optional indexer log is an untagged reference, not native tagged Option.

manual_exceptions.required_behavior: Grouped nested tick tuples accept NULL or 3/5-field records, checking tick domain and whole-stack arity. A flat derived record cannot express these alternatives.
manual_exceptions.native_limitation: Grouped nested tick tuples accept NULL or 3/5-field records, checking tick domain and whole-stack arity. A flat derived record cannot express these alternatives.
